validationCommands: cd ui && npm install && npm run build

tasks.title: Layered summary model
tasks.description: Extend WeeklySummary to Summary model with granularity (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY), date_from, date_to, key_themes (JSON), action_items (JSON). Add SummaryGranularity PyEnum. Migration 007_summary_model.py.

tasks.title: Summarization service
tasks.description: services/summarizer.py: summarize_notes(notes, granularity, entity_name) -> dict calling LLM. Include token budget, chunking for large note sets.

tasks.title: Scheduled background summarization
tasks.description: Background job that runs summarization on schedule. API endpoint to trigger. Integrates with existing cron/job infrastructure.

tasks.title: Review view overhaul
tasks.description: ui/src/views/Review.jsx: Progressive summary display, date picker, granularity selector, action items list.

tasks.title: AI link proposal generation
tasks.description: services/link_proposer.py: analyze notes, propose links based on semantic similarity, shared entities, temporal patterns. Returns list of {from_note_id, to_note_id, reason, confidence}.

tasks.title: Link proposals API
tasks.description: api/proposals.py: GET /api/v1/proposals (list pending), POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/accept (create link), POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/dismiss. Trigger generation: POST /api/v1/proposals/generate.

tasks.title: Proposals in NoteDetailView
tasks.description: NoteDetailView: show proposed links panel with accept/dismiss. Show confirmed links with backlinks.

tasks.title: Proposals in Review view
tasks.description: Review.jsx: show pending link proposals with context, bulk accept/dismiss, accept-all option.

tasks.title: Structured weekly review workflow
tasks.description: Replace static Review layout with guided step-by-step process: Clear Inbox, Review Projects, Review Areas, Orphan Notes, Link Proposals, Insights, Plan next week. Progress bar, collapsible sections, state in localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: 7-step guided review flow with progress bar
Each section collapsible, state persisted in localStorage
Review can be paused and resumed

tasks.title: Orphan note review step
tasks.description: Orphan notes list (zero links, no project, no area). Per note: quick-assign project/area, quick-link, or archive. Bulk archive all orphans with confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Orphan notes list showing notes with 0 links and no project/area
Per-note: assign project dropdown, assign area dropdown, quick-link button
Bulk 'archive all orphans' with confirmation dialog

tasks.title: Weekly digest summary card
tasks.description: Auto-generated digest at top of Review: 'You captured N notes, created M tasks, completed K projects, made L connections.' Stats from DB queries over week date range.
acceptanceCriteria: Digest card at top of Review view
Shows note count, task count, completed project count, link count for past 7 days
Data sourced from real DB queries

tasks.title: Health metrics API
tasks.description: GET /api/v1/metrics/health — returns total_notes, orphan_rate, avg_links_per_note, inbox_count, archive_ratio, tag_coverage, active_projects, stale_projects, weekly_capture_rate, link_proposals_pending.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/metrics/health returns all specified metrics
Endpoint returns valid JSON with all fields populated from DB

tasks.title: Dashboard health card
tasks.description: Dashboard.jsx: 'Knowledge Health' card with orphan rate indicator (green/yellow/red), avg links per note target, weekly capture rate sparkline, inbox count urgency color.
acceptanceCriteria: Health card in Dashboard shows orphan_rate, avg_links, capture_rate, inbox
Color coding: inbox >20 yellow, >50 red
4-week capture rate mini bar chart

tasks.title: Health history tracking
tasks.description: Store weekly health snapshots in weekly_summaries with entity_type='system'. Show 12-week trend chart in Review → System Health tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly snapshots stored in DB as system entity_type weekly_summaries
12-week trend chart in Review System Health tab
Chart shows orphan_rate and capture_rate over time

tasks.title: Rollup service
tasks.description: services/rollup.py: rollup_project_to_area(project_id) — summarizes all project notes with Claude, creates summary note in parent Area tagged #retrospective #project-complete, archives project.
acceptanceCriteria: rollup_project_to_area(project_id) function in services/rollup.py
Creates summary note in parent Area with #retrospective #project-complete
Archives the project after rollup
Returns the created summary note

tasks.title: Archive project with confirmation
tasks.description: PATCH /api/v1/projects/<id> with is_archived=true: if project has parent area, show rollup confirmation. ProjectFocus.jsx: 'Complete Project' button triggers multi-step flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Completing a project with a parent area shows rollup confirmation
'Complete Project' button triggers rollup flow, then archives project
Navigate to area after archiving

tasks.title: Retrospective note template
tasks.description: Rollup generates a structured retrospective: What was accomplished, Key decisions, Lessons learned, Outstanding items. Template applied via Claude prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Retrospective note follows the template structure
Includes all project notes content in prompt for context
Output is well-formatted markdown

tasks.title: Richer graph node types and link visualization
tasks.description: Graph shows Resource nodes (square), Daily note nodes (calendar icon). Link lines: different colors per type (related=purple, child_of=blue, depends_on=orange, mentions=grey). Link thickness proportional to weight.
acceptanceCriteria: Resource nodes render as squares, Daily note nodes show calendar icon
Link lines colored by type
Link thickness reflects semantic similarity weight

tasks.title: Graph cluster detection and visual grouping
tasks.description: D3 force clustering: nodes grouped by project/area with light hull background. Hull color matches project/area color. 'Cluster by: Project | Area | Tag | None' toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Nodes grouped into cluster hulls by project or area
Hull color matches project/area color
Toggle control for clustering mode

tasks.title: Graph heat map mode
tasks.description: 'Activity heat map' toggle: node size proportional to backlink count. Highly-connected notes (MOC candidates) appear larger. Color spectrum: low activity (grey) → high activity (bright accent).
acceptanceCriteria: Heat map toggle in graph controls
Node size scales with backlink count
Color gradient from grey (low) to accent (high activity)

tasks.title: Graph search and filter
tasks.description: Filter panel: show only selected node types, only nodes in selected projects/areas. Search by label: zoom to + highlight matching node. 'Focus mode': select node → show only 1-hop neighbors.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter panel filters by node type and project/area
Search highlights and zooms to matching node
Focus mode shows only selected node + direct neighbors

mergePolicy: Merge validated task commits into overhaul/full-implementation-loop only; merge to main after all phases pass end-to-end validation.
queuePolicy: When no pending tasks remain, convert the next PLAN.md slice into bounded tasks with acceptance criteria before launching implementation agents.
